{"summary": "Cluster mgmt shows no critical/high vulnerabilities or secrets in the digest. The main risks are the Argo CD 'platform' project with fully wildcard scope, the cluster-admin ServiceAccount used by argocd-manager, and unpinned Argo revisions. Remaining items are low/medium hardening gaps (seccomp, immutable filesystem, medium CVEs).", "targets": ["mgmt"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 14, "failed": 6, "skipped": 6, "score": 75}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 12, "failed": 4, "skipped": 6, "score": 80}, {"name": "Trivy PSS", "passed": 16, "failed": 1, "skipped": 0, "score": null}], "findings": [{"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Argo CD 'platform' project is fully permissive", "resource": "AppProject/platform", "controls": [], "evidence": "rbac_and_argo shows project platform with wildcard_destination, wildcard_sources and all_cluster_resources all true; app alloy uses this project.", "fix": "Restrict spec.destinations, spec.sourceRepos and clusterResourceWhitelist in AppProject platform to the specific repos, clusters, namespaces and kinds required."}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "argocd-manager ServiceAccount bound to cluster-admin", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/argocd-manager (ServiceAccount kube-system/argocd-manager)", "controls": [], "evidence": "The digest lists binding argocd-manager granting role cluster-admin to ServiceAccount:kube-system/argocd-manager; combined with the wildcard platform project this gives broad cluster control via Argo CD.", "fix": "Replace with a scoped ClusterRole, or keep cluster-admin only if required and restrict who can sync via AppProject and Argo RBAC."}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Argo apps track mutable revisions and root app uses default project", "resource": "Application/root, Application/alloy", "controls": [], "evidence": "argo_apps_risky shows root in project default at revision HEAD and alloy at revision main.", "fix": "kubectl -n argocd patch app root --type merge -p '{"spec":{"project":"<scoped-project>","source":{"targetRevision":"<tag-or-commit-sha>"}}}'"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Pods missing seccomp profile", "resource": "Workloads (2 failures, names not in digest)", "controls": ["Trivy PSS 10"], "evidence": "trivy pss control 10 Seccomp failed with 2 fails.", "fix": "securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Medium-severity image vulnerabilities", "resource": "Cluster images (not itemised in digest)", "controls": [], "evidence": "trivy k8s reports 8 MEDIUM vulnerabilities and no critical/high; fixed versions are not given in the digest.", "fix": "Review trivy k8s report and bump the affected images to the fixed versions."}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Writable container root filesystems", "resource": "argocd/Deployment/argocd-server (+3 more)", "controls": ["C-0017"], "evidence": "kubescape C-0017 failed on 4 resources; trivy k8s also reports 4 LOW misconfigurations (not itemised).", "fix": "securityContext:
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true  # add emptyDir mounts for writable paths"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin (Group system:masters)", "controls": [], "evidence": "Binding cluster-admin gives cluster-admin to Group system:masters, which looks like the platform default.", "fix": "No change needed; restrict membership of system:masters credentials."}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Other failed NSA/MITRE controls", "reason": "digest lists only C-0017 among failed controls although NSA shows 6 and MITRE 4 failures"}, {"item": "Skipped kubescape controls", "reason": "6 skipped in each framework with no reason given"}]}
